ideas.pitch: A gamified mini-app where players explore a virtual map of Manali, collecting tokenized local medicinal plants and completing conservation quests backed by smart contracts.
ideas.title: Himalayan Herbalist Web3 Quest
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the strong Web3 and gaming partner ecosystem mentioned in the hackathon brief, combining local flavor with blockchain transaction testing.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered autonomous agent marketplace that allows hikers to securely hire decentralized guide services and pay via USDC escrow on Base.
ideas.title: Agentic Mountain Guide
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the rise of agentic workflows seen in recent hackathons while solving a practical problem for offline mountainous regions like Manali.

ideas.pitch: A mobile web platform tracking clean-up efforts on mountain trails, utilizing gamification and blockchain rewards to incentivize eco-friendly tourism.
ideas.title: EcoTrail Gamified Waste Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses sustainability in the Himalayas, capturing the attention of judges looking for real-world local impact.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered no-code trading and strategy platform tailored for niche localized token economies and regional gaming assets.
ideas.title: PeakPulse Trading Bot for Mountain Assets
ideas.why_it_could_win: Translates high-performing automated trading bot architecture into a gamified, creative format suited for the hackathon's gaming and Web3 focus.

ideas.pitch: A Web3 homebase application where builders and travelers can customize 3D avatars and virtual alpine cabins, exploring a metaverse centered around the Manali community.
ideas.title: Meta-Manali Virtual Homestay
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to the Web3 creator track and provides an engaging, interactive demo for judges during the offline finale.
